notes: Kocira 2018 is a multi-year, multi-cultivar soybean study with Fylloton (SWE biostimulant) applied at two doses (0.7% and 1.0%) and two frequencies (single and double foliar spraying). The GT has 36 rows representing 3 cultivars (Annushka, Mavka, Atlanta) each measured across 3 years (identified by differing control means within each cultivar group), with 4 treatment combinations per year: 2 doses x 2 frequencies. The JSON extractor correctly identified all 3 cultivars and 4 dose/frequency arms for the 'Seed yield (t/ha)' outcome, yielding 12 matched JSON observations that are reused across 3 GT year-rows per cultivar. GT means appear to be in a 0.1x scaled unit relative to JSON (GT ctrl ~0.28-0.36 vs JSON ctrl ~2.88-3.63 t/ha), suggesting a data entry unit difference (possibly kg/plant vs t/ha, or a 10x scaling artifact in the GT spreadsheet). Effect percentages agree well for many pairs (several within 1-5%), confirming correct matching. Larger divergences (5-15%) are attributable to year-specific responses. The JSON also extracted 'Number of seeds per m2' and '1,000 seed weight' as separate outcomes which were not targeted by Li 2022 GT for this paper. All 36 GT rows are matched; no coverage failures.
